comment: Foundational i18n configuration for AikiField.com. Locales are listed with their native (endonym) names rather than flags, because flags represent nations and can be politically sensitive.
_supportedLocalesNote: Only list a locale here once data/i18n-strings/<locale>.json is an actual translation, not an untranslated English stub (_meta.is_source: false with content byte-identical to en.json). fr/de/pt/ja/zh/ko/ar/he/fa/hi are still stubs as of 2026-08 — offering them would silently serve English (and, for ar/he/fa, apply dir="rtl" to English text). Move a locale back into supportedLocales as soon as its stub is replaced with a real translation.
_textExpansionNote: Translations can be 30-40% longer than English; layouts should leave room for expansion.
